description.zh: ISV子客户的SpaceId/实例ID。即通道ID，在[通道管理](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)界面查看。
description.en: This is the instance ID for direct customers or the SpaceId for ISV sub-customers. You can find the ID on the [Channel Management](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement) page.
The group ID. You can call the [ListChatGroup](~~2932629~~) operation to obtain the group ID.

descriptions.zh:
><notice>通过API获取IM群成员列表功能属于Meta内测功能，请联系您的商务经理申请加白。></notice>
- 在调用此接口之前，请确保您创建成功的IM群已添加IM群邀请链接且已有成员通过链接进入IM群。

- 若您没有已创建成功的IM群，可通过[AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~)、[AddChatGroupInviteLink](~~3019211~~)接口创建并添加IM群邀请链接。
descriptions.en:
><notice>

This operation is an internal preview feature. Contact your account manager to request access.

></notice>

- Before calling this operation, ensure you have created an IM group with an invitation link, and that members have joined by using that link.

- To create an IM group and add an invitation link, call the [AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~) and [AddChatGroupInviteLink](~~3019211~~) operations.
